notes: Posted 3 August 2001 with no Coruscant-set cards, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
Starting cards as posted under START: Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Tatooine: Desert Landing Site and Combat Readiness (no Objective); these count toward the 60.
Posted 'Maul' (x3, with 'Maul's Saber') dested Darth Maul (Tatooine); the card titled Maul is a later Virtual Set card.

Posted 'Tatooine JP', 'JP Audience Chamber' and 'JP Lower Passage' dested the Dark Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber and Jabba's Palace: Lower Passages; 'Hoth War Room' dested the Dark Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room) for Responsibility Of Command.

Posted 'DLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Mara Jade' dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'IG-88 w/ Gun' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Dengar w/ Gun' dested Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'Thrawn' dested Grand Admiral Thrawn; 'Twi'lek' dested Twi'lek Advisor; 'Force Lightening' dested Force Lightning; 'Omni Box & It's Worse' dested Ommni Box & It's Worse.
Posted 'Grabber' is printed as written (type UNKNOWN): the deck predates Coruscant's Allegations Of Corruption and the post does not say which grabber.
Section headers (GREEN, RED, BLUE) are not cards. Total is 60 as published.
